title: ScreeningQuestionBank
description: Schema for AI-ready HR screening question datasets

template.description: The actual question text, with optional format variables like {role}, {skill}, {location}

expected_answer_type.description: The data type expected as the answer

is_mandatory.description: Whether this question is mandatory to ask

scoring_importance.description: Importance of the question for candidate evaluation

applicable_roles.description: List of roles this question applies to. If empty, implies all roles.

intent.description: The AI intent behind the question, useful for LLM context
